## Gotchas

- Cache key: both `findAll` variants use the same cache name `vets` with default key generation. Pageable is part of the default key, so the paged result and the full list should not collide, but this was not tested [inferred]
- The `vets` cache has no eviction or size limit configured, and nothing writes vets, so staleness only matters if a write path is added [verified: CacheConfiguration.java:37-51; inferred about writers]
- `Vet` is registered for Java serialization in native hints, so cached values are serialised types [verified: PetClinicRuntimeHints.java:35]
